title: NeSTR: Neural S-Transform Reconstruction for Gaussian SPDEs
summary: We introduce Neural $S$-Transform Reconstruction (NeSTR) for Gaussian stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs). The learned object is not the random solution itself, but its $S$-Transform on a finite dimensional subspace of the white noise test space. For Wick type SPDEs, NeSTR yields a deterministic parametric PDE for the restricted $S$-Transform, and the stochastic solution is recovered from the Taylor coefficients of this transform at the origin.
